packaged_identity_assertions: the permanent status-strip identity is independent of transient control status
the native window title repeats the resolved firmware identity
exact verified OS 1.72 displays OS 1.72 / FILTER 2 + LFO2 VERIFIED
exact OS 1.72 with the extension disabled displays OS 1.72 / STOCK MODE / EXTENSION OFF
an accepted versioned unverified update displays OS 1.73 / UNCHANGED STOCK FALLBACK
the frozen native-Tk self-test validates identity storage and window-title composition
both uploaded packages pass the architecture, signature-seal and firmware-exclusion audit
safety_boundary: The packages contain no Elektron firmware. Identity is derived only after the existing transactional preparation and compatibility decision; it does not relax exact-digest extension gating or modify an accepted unchanged-stock MAIN.
scope_limit: This gate proves the firmware identity presentation contract executes in the frozen native-Tk frontend on both supported macOS architectures and that both packages pass the existing artifact audit. Synthetic CI fixtures do not boot proprietary firmware, and this gate does not claim physical-hardware compatibility, Apple Developer ID notarization, or recovered FPGA pin routing.
